boundary: A control representative is intentionally retrospective and known soluble; it is not a new direction.
No rational cover witness is written to, or read by, a solver job. Cover points are mapped and checked only after the isolated solver exits.
A bounded miss remains a bounded solver outcome, not an obstruction or a Sha conclusion.
witness_hiding: The sealed job schema contains only token, quadrics and solver limits. It contains no alpha, public word, point coordinate, coset label or rational cover witness.
